text: With scope and targets locked, it's time to choose the stack: a hybrid platform, not a single-cloud rebuild.
Azure runs the operational path -- AKS hosts grain-ingest, autoscaled by a Horizontal Pod Autoscaler, writing to Azure SQL.
AWS holds an independent-failure-domain backup target for that data, plus the co-op's existing pricing data warehouse, never in scope to rebuild.
Terraform provisions both clouds, with remote state in an Azure Storage backend using blob-lease locking.
Next: designing the real Azure infrastructure this stack gets built on.
